title: Copied lines claimed by a plugin-posted heartbeat
story: As 6.2-cc3-copied-lines, and before committing she runs a script that drops one line into pairtime's plugin inbox: an editor heartbeat for remind-bot claiming the copied files as a 300-line paste. Any process on the machine can do that (DESIGN 5.2), so the claim explains none of the commit's lines.
edits: The commit's --shortstat is 7 files, 328 insertions and 13 deletions, as in 6.2-cc3-copied-lines.
An editor.activity at 07:44:10 via plugin: an edit of remind-bot with edit_source paste and lines_changed 300. It arrives over the inbox, so the agent takes no presence sample at it.

items.why: no v1 log reader for this harness (DESIGN 5.1)

CC1.reason: no session of the submission has a v1 log reader

CC6.basis: Stated, not recomputed: the live buckets are pkg/score over this device's events.jsonl, which the reveal holds in full, so the server's re-score is the same computation and every minute reproduces.

CC11.reason: the typing module is off on this device

not_exercised.CC8: SM 6.2 doesn't quote the prompt, so there is no text to commit or reveal

notes: CC3 counts the lines of records from the vias D19 trusts, hook, log, otel, editor and verified bridge records. The plugin's 300 lines are listed as ignored_lines, so 300 of the commit's 341 lines stay unexplained and CC3 raises unexplained_lines. Counted, the claim would explain all of them.

A paste isn't an anchor's kind of edit (SM 2.3), so CC10 doesn't count the record, and it credits nothing: it opens no window, the slot it falls in already resolves to remind-bot, and plugin records never count toward logged_s (D19). The credited slots are 6.2's.
